success.Label: Success
success.Text: It goes as well as intended.

partial.Label: Partial Success
partial.Text: They do it but also suffer a Consequence: Harm, Reduced Effect, Lost Opportunity, Worse Position or Complication.

fail.Label: Fail
fail.Text: Things go bad and they suffer the Consequences.

critical.Label: Perfect
critical.Text: You avoid the consequence completely and refresh 1 Blood.

FirearmAction.ReloadOption: Reload: 1d per Blood or bullet marked

FirearmOutcome.parryMiss: The enemy action is not interrupted.
FirearmOutcome.stunHit: You stun an enemy for a few seconds.

Field.ReloadBonus: Bonus dice (Reload only, e.g. Noble Scion)

Card.PositionEffectRaised: {position} position, {effect} effect (raised by the alternate form)
Card.ZeroDice: {dice}: zero dice, rolled 2 and kept the lowest

Reminder.ReloadBullet: Mark {marked} Blood and/or Silver Bullets, then regain {n} bullet.
Reminder.ReloadBullets: Mark {marked} Blood and/or Silver Bullets, then regain {n} bullets.

Notify.NoActor: Select your Hunter's token or assign a character.
Notify.StunTooFew: Stun rolls 1 die per two bullets marked: mark at least 2.

Hunt.Title: Start the Hunt
Hunt.Intro: Every choice starts drawn from the Adventure's tables. Change any of them, or press the die to draw again. Only you see the result.

Overview.OpeningText: Right after the Hunters arrive, present {obstacle}. Somewhere along the way they may meet {character}.
Overview.Clock: The Night's Clock is on the clocks window. Advance it when the Hunters move between places, or as a Consequence.
Overview.Describe: Picture your Heliwyr: its smells, its spires, its statues.
Overview.Points: Give each location three points of interest. A Hunter who observes or interacts with one gains 1 Insight.
Overview.Enemies: Give each location its obstacles and enemies.

Cathedral.Secret: Secret. The Apostle {apostle} hides here. When the Hunters reach this cathedral, its special rule applies.

Apostle.Prompt: What monstrosity has defaced their flesh? What are they doing when the Hunters arrive, and how do they prepare to fight? The Apostle takes the initiative.

Location.PointsHint: Strange, alienating details. Don't explain them. 1 Insight for the Hunter who finds one.

Obstacle.Text: Present it as soon as the Hunters arrive in Heliwyr, so they immediately have something to solve.

Notify.GMOnly: Only a GM can start the hunt.
Notify.Missing: Import the Bloodstone Adventure first: the hunt needs its Map of Heliwyr, GM journal and tables.
